title: Mera Qasim Na Raha
body:
Roke Farwah Ne Kaha Mera Qasim Na Raha
Ab Nahi Koi Mera Qasim Na Raha
Maa Ye Ab Kaise Jiye Gham Tera Kaise Sahe
Roke Boli Mamta Mera Qasim Na Raha
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Ibne Hasan Misl-e-Gul Tera Baadan
Ran Me Yun Pamal Huwa Mera Qasim Na Raha
Zulm Karte Hai Laen Koi Yawar Bhi Nahi
Kya Kare Ab Ye Dukhya Mera Qasim Na Raha
<<DIVIDER>>
Honge Be-Ghar Ghar Se Ab Hamara Sar Se
Chini Jaegi Rida Mera Qasim Na Raha
Kaisi Ye Thi Shadi Jo Huwi Barbadi
Hogai Bewa Kubra Mera Qasim Na Raha
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaise Dekhe Madar Beta Tere Sar Par
Zakhmo Ka Hai Sehra Mera Qasim Na Raha
Gham Se Phatta Tha Jigar Bain Sun Kar Aayi Nazar
Kehti Thi Jab Farwa Mera Qasim Na Raha
